section: Choosing a managed services provider for AV, UC and digital signage: AVI-SPL's top considerations
body:
This Concept Catalog article lists what AVI-SPL suggests weighing when an organization considers outsourcing technology monitoring, management and support, and how to judge a provider. It helps when a customer is deciding who will run the rooms once they are in service.

**What to know**

- **Outsource or keep support in-house.** Start by asking whether the internal IT support team has AV, UC and digital signage expertise and, if it does, how much time it can give to proactive monitoring and management as opposed to reactive fixes. Where the experience is missing, upskilling is an option. The article also asks whether internal teams would be better used on more strategic digital transformation goals, and notes that outsourcing may save the team time and frustration.
- **Level and breadth of expertise.** The partner should have the expertise the internal team lacks. Review everything a vendor would need to cover. The examples given are unified communications platforms, multi-cloud management, and audio visual technology with digital signage players.
- **Support availability at any time.** Technology problems cannot always be predicted, and users and IT staff prefer talking to a person over an answering service, a chat or email queue, or a chatbot. The article therefore recommends a partner offering live, expert phone support 24/7. The partner should also work to limit downtime and support tickets through scheduled preventative maintenance and proactive upgrades, and carry out services at times convenient for the customer and its teams.
- **End-to-end solution.** Managed services go well beyond break/fix support, although that is included. The article lists what an end-to-end solution includes: monitoring and live support 24/7, asset inventory services, multi-cloud management, visits for preventative maintenance, and dispatch of local service technicians. It advises looking for the flexibility to add services as needed.
- **Simplified pricing with room to grow.** Complicated pricing and multiple contracts make outsourcing less helpful. Pricing should be straightforward, and contracts should leave room to grow when meeting rooms or devices are added.

The article closes by presenting AVI-SPL Enterprise Managed Services as a program developed to meet these considerations.

**When to use this**: a customer asking whether to outsource meeting room support, or what criteria to use when comparing managed services providers.

**Not stated in this source**: prices, response times and contract lengths.
